core: ER membrane-bound transcription factor activation of sterol genes
qualifier: ATF6 and CREB3 unfolded protein response arm
name: SREBP and ATF6/CREB3 ER-bound transcription factor activation
rationale: All members concern ER-anchored transcription factors (SREBP, ATF6, CREB3) and their cholesterol or chaperone target genes; the ATF6/CREB3 UPR arm is what the sterol-only confusables lack.

qualifier: HIF hypoxia sensing with p53 and mTORC1 glycolytic control
name: HIF hypoxic glycolytic reprogramming with p53 and mTORC1
rationale: Members share oxygen- and nutrient-stress control of glycolysis and nucleotide metabolism via HIF, p53 and mTORC1, distinguishing it from fructose/fermentation and NRF2-centred confusables.

qualifier: MHC class II exogenous peptide
name: MHC class II exogenous peptide antigen presentation
rationale: All members concern loading and regulation of exogenous peptide presentation on MHC class II, unlike confusables on MHC class I cross-presentation, lipid antigen or DC surface signatures.

qualifier: RUNX2-regulated chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation
name: RUNX2-regulated chondrocyte and osteoblast skeletal development
rationale: Members cover cartilage and bone formation through chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation (RUNX2, BMP/Wnt), whereas confusables centre on osteoclast remodelling, collagen secretion or cadherin regulation.

qualifier: connexin gap junctions and presynaptic calcium control
name: Neuronal gap junction and presynaptic calcium signalling
rationale: Members combine connexon assembly and electrical transmission with presynaptic calcium and mGluR signalling in neurons, which separates it from purely presynaptic-modulation and gap-junction-regulation confusables.

qualifier: responses to calcium and caffeine
name: Cardiomyocyte calcium handling and response to calcium and caffeine
rationale: Members concern cytosolic calcium control in cardiac muscle (Na/Ca exchange, sequestration, membrane potential); responses to calcium and caffeine and calcium-channel activation distinguish it from SR-pump-focused confusables.

qualifier: melanosome and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis
name: Melanosome and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis in pigmentation
rationale: Members cover melanin synthesis, melanosome/pigment granule and platelet dense granule biogenesis via coated-vesicle cargo loading, unlike confusables on organelle acidification, lysosomal targeting or other MITF programmes.

qualifier: fork reversal, DNA topology and recombinational telomere maintenance
name: Replication fork stress resolution and recombinational telomere maintenance
rationale: Members concern resolving replication-stress structures (fork reversal, R-loops, topology, recombination intermediates) and replication/recombination-based telomere maintenance, versus confusables on telomere capping and NHEJ protection.

qualifier: aspartate transport and glutamate transporter disorders
name: Aspartate transport and glutamate transporter genetic disorders
rationale: All members concern aspartate/glutamate transporters (SLC1A1, SLC1A3, SLC17A8) and their diseases, unlike confusables on astrocytic glutamate reuptake or GABA transport.

qualifier: NAD(P) salvage and coenzyme A with pyruvate dehydrogenase
name: NAD(P) and coenzyme A metabolism with pyruvate dehydrogenase
rationale: Members share NAD(P) and CoA cofactor synthesis/turnover and pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA conversion; NAD salvage and nicotinate metabolism distinguish it from TCA, thiamine and lipoylation confusables.

qualifier: RAS/RAB prenylation and Wnt ligand acylation
name: RAS/RAB prenylation and Wnt ligand lipidation for secretion
rationale: Members concern lipid modification of proteins (geranylgeranylation of RAS/RAB, PORCN acylation of Wnt) and resulting trafficking, distinguishing it from Hedgehog palmitoylation and phospholipid-transfer confusables.

qualifier: pesticides, ethanol and aryl hydrocarbon receptor
name: Response to organic xenobiotics, pesticides and ethanol
rationale: Members are responses to organic chemicals (pesticides, dioxin via AhR, ethanol, nicotine, anesthetics), unlike confusables on metal ions, vitamin C or cytotoxic drugs.

qualifier: ABCA1-mediated HDL assembly
name: ABCA1-mediated cholesterol and phospholipid efflux for HDL assembly
rationale: All members concern ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol and phospholipid efflux and nascent HDL assembly, while confusables cover lipoprotein remodelling, clearance and cholesterol uptake.

qualifier: LXR regulation of lipogenic, gluconeogenic and lipolytic genes
name: LXR-regulated lipogenic, gluconeogenic and lipolytic gene expression
rationale: Members concern LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) nuclear receptor control of metabolic genes, distinguishing it from PPAR/clock, adipogenesis and lipid droplet confusables.

qualifier: zinc, copper, manganese and metallothionein detoxification
name: Zinc, copper and manganese homeostasis and metallothionein detoxification
rationale: Members cover transport, sensing (MTF1) and metallothionein detoxification of zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium, unlike confusables centred on iron/heme or heavy-metal response.

qualifier: white fat cell proliferation and PPAR signalling regulation
name: Regulation of white fat cell proliferation and PPAR signalling
rationale: Members concern control of white adipose expansion and PPAR signalling, including its restraint, versus confusables on adipocyte differentiation programmes or brown/beige fat.

qualifier: surfactant homeostasis and pneumocyte differentiation
name: Pulmonary surfactant homeostasis and alveolar pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover surfactant metabolism and its disorders plus alveolar pneumocyte and saccule development, distinguishing it from gas-transport, membrane-scrambling and airway branching confusables.

qualifier: cholinergic, serotonergic and adenosine receptors with cAMP control
name: Cholinergic, serotonergic and adenosine receptor signalling
rationale: Members are acetylcholine (nicotinic/muscarinic), serotonin and adenosine receptor signalling with cAMP regulation, unlike confusables on histamine/serotonin synthesis, adrenergic or tachykinin signalling.

qualifier: urea cycle and glutathione
name: Amino acid metabolism with urea cycle and glutathione
rationale: Members span amino acid synthesis, catabolism and transport, with urea cycle, sulfur amino acid and glutathione metabolism distinguishing it from TCA/gluconeogenic and selenium confusables.

qualifier: adhesion receptors GPVI and GPIb-IX-V
name: Platelet adhesion and activation via GPVI and GPIb-IX-V
rationale: All members concern platelet activation and aggregation, with collagen/GPVI and GPIb-IX-V adhesion signalling distinguishing it from ADP/thrombin GPCR and VWF/degranulation confusables.

qualifier: CYP2E1 oxidation and N-acetylation of aromatic compounds
name: CYP2E1 oxidation and N-acetylation of aromatic xenobiotics
rationale: Members concern phase I CYP2E1 and acetylation metabolism of aromatic nitrogen compounds such as paracetamol, unlike confusables on other CYPs, glycine conjugation or sulfonation/methylation.

qualifier: NRF2 and HIF
name: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF hypoxia transcriptional programs
rationale: Members cover NRF2 (and BACH1) antioxidant gene regulation and HIF oxygen sensing, distinguishing it from p53/mTORC1, FOXO and ferroptosis confusables.

core: Inner ear sensory hair cell function
qualifier: mechanosensation for hearing and balance
name: Inner ear hair cell mechanosensation for hearing and balance
rationale: Members concern hair cell specification, stereocilia and auditory/vestibular mechanosensation, unlike confusables on ear morphogenesis or epithelial microvilli.

qualifier: chemokine and integrin-mediated T cell homing
name: Chemokine and integrin-mediated leukocyte homing and T cell migration
rationale: Members share chemokine-guided, integrin-dependent leukocyte (especially T cell) migration and homing, versus confusables on monocyte, B cell or lymphoid-organ trafficking.

qualifier: tubulin glutamylation and severing in spermatogenesis
name: Tubulin glutamylation and microtubule remodelling in spermatogenesis
rationale: Members concern tubulin glutamylation, severing and kinesin-driven microtubule remodelling in sperm development, unlike confusables on axoneme assembly, centrosomes or cilia trafficking.
